items.title: Head of Transactional Processing
items.description: By bringing together next-gen technology and the finest live data available, Genius Sports is enabling a new era of sports for fans worldwide, delivering experiences that are more immersive, interactive and personalised than ever before. Learn more at geniussports.com THE ROLE: The Head of Transactional Processing is being hired to lead the global transactional finance teams at Genius Sports. Continuing to manage all transactional processing in one organizational pillar. This team plays a critical role in driving change and excellence in Accounts Receivable (invoicing and collections), Accounts Payable and Payroll. The role will report directly to the Group Director of Finance and play a key role in driving the finance team forwards and optimizing the way the finance team is organized. Duties & Responsibilities Oversee and manage the Accounts Receivable team of 6 people, led by the Accounts Receivable Controller to ensure accuracy, efficiency, and compliance. Oversee and manage the Accounts Payable team of 6 people led by the Accounts Payable Controller Oversee and manage the payroll team of 6 led by the Global Payroll Manager Develop and implement efficient processes and workflows across transactional functions, driving improvements in speed, accuracy and reliability. Drive project and process improvements in the teams including; AP – roll out of PO/credit card alignment, OCR and standardised AP processing AR – automated billing project, best in class credit control and improved accuracy Payroll – work to define clear roles and responsibilities between people and finance teams and align globally. Drive the global payroll project alongside people team and ensure common global accounting for payroll under one shared vision Establish KPIs for the transactional processing team, monitoring performance and delivering constructive feedback to drive performance improvements. Maintain strong relationships with customers and internal commercial stakeholders, ensuring timely and effective resolution of any discrepancies. Build a strong focus on credit control to drive improvements in aging, bad debt and write offs. Ensure all transactional processing is aligned with the company’s financial controls and governance standards. Manage month-end, quarter-end and year-end close processes across accounts payable, receivable and payroll to meet reporting deadlines. items.title: MVNO Networks Manager
items.description: Help Us Build The Future of Travel At Airalo, we're making it easier for people to stay connected wherever they travel. As the world's first eSIM store, we help millions of travelers access affordable mobile data in 200+ countries and regions around the world. Today, we're a team of 400+ people across 60+ countries, building a product used by travelers every day. We've grown quickly, but we've worked hard to keep what matters: trust, ownership, and the freedom for people to do great work without unnecessary layers or bureaucracy. We're fully remote by design, genuinely global, and united by a shared mission to make travel simpler for everyone. Your Next Destination Location: Remote. Contract: Full-time, permanent. Benefits: Learn more about our benefits here in this link - https://airalo-public.notion.site/Benefits-25396a97ffca81fb9bc1f0be479f1be3?pvs=74 Languages: English is our main working language day to day, so you'll need to be comfortable communicating in it both in meetings and async. As an MVNO Networks Manager at Airalo you will be responsible for establishing and managing the host operator partnerships that allow Airalo to operate its own networks locally. You will own each new market from the first conversation with a host mobile network operator through commercial negotiation, regulatory approval and technical integration to commercial launch, and you will remain its commercial owner once it is live. You are someone who owns a market from its business case through to its commercial performance in operation. You are equally at ease negotiating terms with an operator's executive team, scoping the integration with their technical team, and running a service management review once the market is operational. You will work in close coordination with our legal, finance, product, engineering and core network teams, as the local networks you establish need to interoperate with Airalo's existing platform and services. Why People Join Us We started Airalo to make staying connected effortless, wherever you are in the world. Today, millions of travelers rely on our eSIMs, and many of the people building the product were customers first. Our team spans 60+ countries, united by a shared belief that great work happens when people are trusted to own what they do. There's trust to own what you do, space to focus without constant layers of process, and a clear sense of what you're responsible for from day one. As Airalo continues to grow, so do the opportunities to learn, take on new challenges, and make a real impact - from anywhere in the world. Before You Hit Apply By applying, you acknowledge and agree that, in case of successful application, Airalo may request to run background checks as a condition for entering into an agreement with you. Rest assured that these checks will only occur upon your prior consent and at the end of the selection process, and will be strictly limited to what is allowed under the laws that are applicable to you. All data that you share or that we collect in connection with such checks will be processed in accordance with our Privacy Policy, available here: www.airalo.com/more-info/privacy-policy?srsltid=AfmBOooBT0rXAj1FaNelZ3VfN0wvhwzvAoxdtHnOKSVETpiSjiXVuycy We sincerely thank all applicants in advance for submitting their interest in this opportunity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations upon request for individuals with disabilities throughout our job interview process. items.title: 数据开发工程师（实时计算方向）
items.description: 【岗位定位】 1、公司已经建立较完善的数据仓库和实时数据体系，具备数据采集、计算、存储及服务能力。随着业务规模增长和实时应用场景增加，我们希望引入两名中高级数据开发工程师，负责实时数据需求交付、任务优化及工程治理。 2、该岗位以实时数据开发为主，同时参与离线数仓建设。你将重点解决实时链路中的数据延迟、状态膨胀、资源消耗、数据质量及一致性等问题，推动实时数据体系向更稳定、更高效、更规范的方向演进。 【岗位职责】 1、负责实时数据需求的分析、方案设计和开发交付，基于Flink、Kafka等技术建设实时数据处理链路，为实时分析、监控、指标及业务决策等场景提供数据支持。 2、参与实时数仓建设及模型设计，结合业务需求完成数据分层、指标口径、维度模型和数据服务的设计与落地。 3、持续优化现有实时任务，解决数据延迟、反压、Checkpoint异常、状态膨胀、资源利用率不合理及数据不一致等问题，提升任务稳定性和计算效率。 4、参与数据治理和工程质量建设，包括任务依赖梳理、元数据管理、数据质量监控、告警机制、开发规范及问题排查体系建设。 5、参与大数据平台及计算引擎的日常维护和问题处理，协同上下游团队保障数据链路的稳定性、准确性和时效性。 6、沉淀实时开发最佳实践和技术经验，通过技术分享、代码评审及方案评审，提升团队整体实时研发能力。 【任职要求】 1、本科及以上学历，计算机、软件工程、信息技术或相关专业，具有5年及以上数据开发或大数据研发经验；能力优秀者可适当放宽。 2、具备完整的数据仓库项目经验，熟悉实时数仓架构、数据分层和数据模型设计，能够将业务需求转化为数据模型及技术方案。 3、熟练掌握Flink，具有Flink SQL、DataStream API等实际项目经验，理解State、Checkpoint、Watermark、窗口、反压和容错机制。 4、具备实时任务开发及优化经验，能够独立分析和解决任务延迟、资源消耗较高、状态异常、数据倾斜及数据一致性等问题。 5、熟悉Kafka及实时数据链路，理解数据采集、传输、计算、存储和服务的完整流程。 6、熟悉Hadoop、Hive、Spark等大数据技术，具备一定的离线数据开发能力。 7、熟练掌握SQL，能够完成复杂数据加工和性能优化；至少熟悉Python、Java或Scala中的一种开发语言。 8、熟悉MySQL、PostgreSQL、Elasticsearch等常用数据库或存储系统。 9、具备良好的业务理解、沟通协作和书面表达能力，责任心强，能够主动推动问题解决和项目落地。 【加分项】 1、具有大规模Flink任务开发、性能调优或集群治理经验。 2、具有实时数仓架构优化、实时链路治理或技术升级经验。 3、熟悉Hologres、ClickHouse、Doris等实时OLAP技术。 4、具有实时指标、实时监控、实时风控、实时推荐等复杂业务场景经验。 【我们期待的候选人】 1、我们希望你不仅能够完成数据需求开发，也愿意深入理解实时计算机制，关注数据链路的稳定性、性能和工程质量。 2、面对复杂问题，你能够从数据、代码、任务配置和运行机制等多个角度定位原因，并将解决方案沉淀为可复用的规范、工具或最佳实践。 【岗位定位】 items.title: Solution Operations Manager, Strategic Accounts
items.description: ABOUT MISTRAL Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms. We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited. ABOUT THE ROLE Mistral AI partners with the leaders of their industries to redefine how their most complex, high-stakes challenges are solved with frontier AI. As a Solutions Operations Manager for our strategic accounts, you act as the chief of staff to the account leadership: you sit at the heart of the transformation, working with the client's leadership and with Mistral's best deployment strategists, forward-deployed engineers and applied scientists. You keep every account running like clockwork and run point on operations to maximize the impact of Mistral's resources. This is a hands-on role for someone who blends consulting-grade strategic thinking with the pragmatism of an operator, who embeds in their accounts and owns the outcome, and who brings AI into the day-to-day of the account. WHAT YOU'LL DO As the operational backbone of the account, you will act as the Chief of Staff to the Program Lead, to ensure Mistral sets the high standard for execution, speed, and collaboration with the client. Your role blends strategic governance, hands-on project management, operational innovation, and internal automation to keep initiatives on track and stakeholders aligned. GOVERNANCE & STRATEGIC ALIGNMENT - Ensure the Program Lead’s vision is clearly articulated and adopted by both Mistral’s account team and the client - Drive alignment between client stakeholders and Mistral teams to ensure shared priorities and high-quality delivery standards - Facilitate data-driven decision-making for leadership through weekly cadences, steering committee prep, and risk dashboards. STRATEGIC SCOPING & VALUE DEFINITION - Develop a deep understanding of the client’s business, operating model, and strategic priorities - Partner with the Program Lead and Account team to scope transformative programs, identify and define use cases, and build a clear business case and value framework - Translate strategic ambition into measurable outcomes and track the long-term business impact of each program DELIVERY & EXECUTION - Own delivery frameworks: timelines, milestones, reporting, proactively securing commitments and flagging risks or delays early. - Optimize delivery processes by identifying friction points and standardizing workflows to enhance quality and predictability. OPERATIONAL INNOVATION & AUTOMATION - Build and enhance Mistral’s platform and internal tools to empower program delivery with scalable, tailored solutions - Automate workflows to eliminate manual friction in planning, reporting, and follow-ups, accelerating execution and reducing operational overhead WHO YOU ARE - Strategic operator. You bring 3–5 years of experience in top-tier strategy consulting or as a Chief of Staff in top startup/scale-up, with the structured thinking, adaptability, and clear communication that comes with it. - AI-fluent. You genuinely use AI tools to automate your own work: drafting, analysis, reporting, PMO tasks. You're comfortable building and iterating on automations, not just prompting a chatbot. - High agency. You don't wait to be told what to do. You see the gap, you close it, and you raise the standard as you go. - Customer-centric. You can hold a room with senior enterprise stakeholders and translate between business strategy and technical delivery. - Meticulous and reliable. items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role As a Marketing Events Manager, International at Anthropic, you will own the execution of events across our international markets that drive pipeline, deepen customer relationships, and build Anthropic's brand and share of mind in markets where we're growing fast. You'll deliver a portfolio ranging from global flagship programs adapted for local markets to brand activations, executive dinners, roundtables, customer summits, and third-party events. This role sits on the Marketing Events Team, reports to the Head of International Events, and partners closely with International Sales, regional Field Marketing, Communications, Policy, Product Marketing, and Creative. You'll bring hands-on operational excellence and a strong eye for brand storytelling, turning plans into experiences that resonate with diverse audiences, from developers to enterprise executives to policymakers. As part of a small team building Anthropic's international events program, you'll help create the systems, processes, and playbooks that let it scale across regions. Responsibilities: Develop and execute international events that deliver on brand objectives, regional sales priorities, and pipeline targets, while contributing to strategy that supports overall company goals Plan and manage a diverse, multi-country portfolio spanning hosted flagship events, brand activations, industry conferences, and cultural moments Adapt global event programs for international markets, working with the Marketing Events team so programs stay aligned with company-wide strategy while meeting local market needs Work with Creative on event identities, spatial design, and experiential elements that bring Anthropic's brand to life, ensuring our presence is compelling and consistent across all touchpoints Oversee event budgets, vendor relationships, and contract negotiations, ensuring strong ROI across the portfolio Collaborate cross-functionally with Product Marketing, Policy, and Communications to align event messaging and maximize the impact of Anthropic's presence at industry moments Build and maintain operational frameworks that keep quality and brand consistency high across regions: speaker and staff briefings, Know Before You Go documentation, and post-event reporting Provide on-site leadership and logistics management, serving as the primary point of contact for all event operations during live experiences Identify opportunities to innovate on event formats and experiences that differentiate Anthropic in the AI landscape You may be a good fit if you: Have 8+ years of B2B event marketing and management experience, including brand-owned, technical, or innovation-focused events across EMEA and/or APAC, at a high-growth technology company Have a proven track record of executing multi-country event programs that deliver brand impact, and measurable pipeline and revenue results Have a strong portfolio of events, including brand events, that turn a company's values and positioning into memorable, on-brand experiences Have experience activating at premium third-party events, including hospitality at high-end venues, sporting events, and cultural experiences Are highly organized, with exceptional project management skills and the ability to run multiple complex events at once, often in different markets Are a collaborative partner who builds strong relationships across International Sales, Marketing, and executive stakeholders Have strong budget and vendor management experience, including local suppliers and multiple currencies Have the cultural awareness and judgement to adapt events for different markets Can operate in a fast-paced environment and maintain calm and effective leadership in high-pressure situations Have strong data analysis skills to measure and report on event success metrics Are comfortable with regular travel across EMEA and APAC (approximately 30%) Strong candidates may also: Have experience with event technology platforms and meeting scheduling tools (e.g., Splash, Cvent, or similar) Have worked closely with enterprise sales teams and understand the enterprise buying cycle Have worked with creative teams and agencies on event identities, spatial design, and experiential elements Have managed or mentored other team members Have a genuine interest in AI technology and care about ensuring that transformative AI systems are developed safely The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: £125,000 — £125,000 GBP Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. As a Data Scientist in the consumer org, you'll apply these skills to improve the customer experience across Coinbase's consumer products—spot and advanced trading, yield, Coinbase One (CB1), international expansion, and new launches (including prediction markets and equities trading). items.title: Software Engineer, Compute Foundations
items.description: ABOUT THE TEAM Compute Foundations builds the software that manages OpenAI’s GPU compute infrastructure across sites, data centers, and infrastructure providers, supporting model training and inference. Our systems turn large, heterogeneous fleets of machines into dependable compute for research and products. We build Kubernetes-based control planes, controllers, services, and APIs that coordinate the lifecycle of machines and clusters. We connect global infrastructure management with the realities of bare-metal systems, giving clients consistent interfaces across differences in hardware, topology, and provider behavior. ABOUT THE ROLE You will build distributed systems that provision, configure, and manage compute throughout its lifecycle. Your work will connect global services and Kubernetes controllers with the systems that bring machines online, update them safely, and recover them when something goes wrong. This role combines software architecture with an understanding of how machines and data centers work. You might design a lifecycle API, improve controller performance under high concurrency and provider rate limits, or trace a provisioning failure from an API through reconciliation to network boot or host configuration. You will help these systems remain reliable as the fleet expands across sites and generations of GPU hardware. We value depth in relevant systems and the ability to connect layers. You do not need to arrive as an expert in every component of the stack. IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL: - Design, build, and operate Kubernetes-based controllers and distributed services that coordinate infrastructure across sites, isolate failures, and scale as GPU capacity grows. - Define APIs and resource models that let clients request and track lifecycle operations through consistent interfaces across hardware platforms and providers. - Build provisioning and configuration services that coordinate network boot, hardware management interfaces, and the deployment of firmware, operating-system images, drivers, and host configuration. - Develop lifecycle management for discovery, allocation, provisioning, upgrades, maintenance, recovery, and decommissioning, integrating with health and validation systems. - Design reliable reconciliation and recovery through concurrent changes, interrupted operations, and partial failures, with staged rollouts that limit disruption across nodes, racks, and clusters. - Improve control-plane throughput, API latency, and the time infrastructure takes to reach its desired state, while respecting the limits of site systems and provider APIs. - Build the software integrations that bring new sites and GPU hardware generations into the platform, partnering with hardware, networking, data-center, and other infrastructure teams. YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU: - Have strong software engineering fundamentals and experience designing, implementing, and owning production distributed systems or infrastructure services. - Have experience developing infrastructure systems that use Kubernetes APIs and reconciliation to manage resources. - Understand how a bare-metal node moves from power-on to a configured, workload-ready system, with depth in one or more areas such as PXE, DHCP/DNS, baseboard management controllers (BMCs), firmware, Linux, drivers, images, or configuration management. - Can design reliable APIs and asynchronous workflows, reasoning about concurrency, consistency, idempotency, and failures across service and provider boundaries. - Can diagnose reliability and performance problems across service, operating-system, and machine boundaries, turning production evidence into lasting software improvements. - Work effectively across engineering specialties and communicate system behavior and technical tradeoffs clearly. BONUS POINTS IF YOU: - Have built infrastructure control planes that coordinate operations across multiple sites or regions. - Have worked with GPU or HPC infrastructure, including topology and shared dependencies across machines, racks, or clusters. - Have integrated multiple hardware platforms or infrastructure providers into a common service or resource model. items.title: Senior Manager, Regulatory Accounting & Disclosures
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role Anthropic's Non-Financial Reporting team owns Anthropic's mandatory mandatory disclosures. In this role, you will own cross functional mechanisms to understand the reporting implications of our compute build out. You will build out data management processes, drive key disclosure strategy decisions, and develop a repeatable approach for responding to customer queries. You will help define how the impact of frontier AI gets measured, disclosed, and verified. Responsibilities Develop and own the internal mechanisms to track and resolve open questions on leases, capex, and other changes to our company footprint, so that financial reporting and non-financial reporting stay aligned. Prepare the mandatory disclosure filings (EU CSRD, AU ASRS, etc.) and successor regimes, and develop risk assessment methodologies to enable compliance with these frameworks. Own corporate reporting on non-financial metrics including carbon, energy, water and other relevant metrics. Ensure our non-financial reporting is assurance-ready: design the controls, documentation, and tech systems to the same standard as our financial reporting, and manage external assurance processes. Assist in developing our disclosure strategy and governance in partnership with legal, communications and policy teams: assess the reporting landscape, and set our voluntary disclosure posture (CDP, EcoVadis, customer-facing statements). Develop a scalable process for responding to customer requests — maintain the answer library, meet SLAs agreed with Sales, and own the methodology for customer-level reporting. Minimum qualifications Deep working knowledge of mandatory reporting standards and experience building a data management plan, documenting methodology choices, and defending them to auditors or assurance providers. Cloud or data-center impact accounting (electricity and energy data, supplier-specific data). Proficiency in maintaining non-financial accounting platforms and managing multi-stakeholder data collection. Familiarity with financial accounting standards accounting and the ability to partner with financial accounting teams. Preferred qualifications 10+ years in reporting experience: has owned regulatory reporting deliverables end to end — mandatory corporate disclosures, voluntary frameworks, or customer-facing reporting (e.g. CDP, EcoVadis, procurement checklists, or similar). CPA, and sustainability reporting credential (FSA Credential, GRI Professional, or similar). Masters degree in accounting, finance, environmental science, engineering, sustainability, or a related quantitative field — or equivalent practical experience. Assurance experience. ISO 14001 experience; public-sector procurement exposure. Experience building a repeatable reporting process from scratch and coordinating across Sales, Legal, Comms and Finance; strong written communication. The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $230,000 — $300,000 USD Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. items.title: Overnight Customer Experience Team Lead
items.description: Join us in building the future of finance. Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading. About the team + role We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. Robinhood’s Customer Experience team plays a critical role in Democratizing Finance for All. Our customer experience team supports customers across a wide range of account needs, delivering timely, accurate, and empathetic support across multiple channels. As a Customer Experience Team Lead, you will help lead a team of customer support representatives responsible for delivering high-quality service and resolving customer issues efficiently. You will coach and develop team members focusing on technical coaching and driving subject matter expertise. You’ll support the Customer Experience Manager to ensure operational excellence, and act as a point of contact for escalations and complex customer situations. In this role, you will help drive performance through coaching, quality standards, and service-level accountability while partnering with operations, quality assurance, and compliance teams to continuously improve the customer experience. Schedule & Work Environment Must reside in or near Denver, CO and be available to attend in-person training onsite. Following training, remote shifts expected with overnight-shift hours at least 5 days a week. The team operates on a 24/7 schedule and you will be expected to work overnight shifts. Employees will work either five 8-hour shifts or four 10-hour shifts per week, depending on business needs. Specific schedules will be determined after hire. At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. What you’ll do Help develop a team of customer experience representatives delivering support directly to our customers Provide ongoing coaching and performance feedback to drive strong customer outcomes and team development Handle escalated customer concerns and resolve complex issues with urgency and professionalism Oversee daily operations including queue management, workforce coordination, and service-level adherence Monitor team performance metrics and partner with leadership to drive continuous improvement Collaborate with QA, operations leaders, and compliance teams to maintain quality standards and ensure regulatory alignment Lead by example by supporting the queues and our customers directly during times of surges What you bring Active FINRA Series 7 and Series 63 ; Series 9/10 or 24 preferred (or ability to obtain 9/10 within 120 days) Strong coaching and leadership skills with a passion for developing frontline talent Excellent written and verbal communication skills Proven ability to operate in a fast-paced, high-volume environment while managing competing priorities Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail Flexibility in scheduling to support business needs What we offer Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career Performance driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching Top Tier benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents Access to the Robinhood Employee Fund that gives eligible US employees the opportunity to invest in a private employee fund that provides exposure to Robinhood Ventures funds. Access to the best AI tools on the market and continuous AI skill-building for every employee, technical or not. Lifestyle wallet - a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more Employer-paid life & disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more! Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces. In addition to the base pay range listed below, this role is also eligible for bonus opportunities + benefits. Base pay for the successful applicant will depend on a variety of job-related factors, which may include education, training, experience, location, business needs, or market demands. The expected base pay range for this role is based on the location where the work will be performed and is aligned to one of 3 compensation zones. For other locations not listed, compensation can be discussed with your recruiter during the interview process. Base Pay Range: Zone 1 (Menlo Park, CA; New York, NY; Bellevue, WA; Washington, DC) $34 — $40 USD Zone 2 (Denver, CO; Westlake, TX; Chicago, IL) $34 — $40 USD Zone 3 (Lake Mary, FL; Clearwater, FL; Gainesville, FL) $33.15 — $39 USD Click here to learn more about our Total Rewards, which vary by region and entity. If our mission energizes you and you’re ready to build the future of finance, we look forward to seeing your application. Robinhood provides equal opportunity for all applicants, offers reasonable accommodations upon request, and complies with applicable equal employment and privacy laws. Inclusion is built into how we hire and work—welcoming different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences so everyone can do their best. Please review the Privacy Policy for your country of application.

items.title: Senior Onchain Investigator
items.description: Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase , we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” learn more about working at Coinbase . Security is a primary competency at Coinbase, and the Threat Intelligence team within Security Operations keeps a watchful eye over every aspect of it. As a Senior Onchain Investigator, you'll own end-to-end onchain investigations into the threat actors targeting Coinbase and the crypto ecosystem. You'll cluster illicit wallets, fuse OSINT with onchain evidence, and turn findings into detections, blocks, and decisions that protect customers and products. This role leads investigation methodology for the team, not just individual cases. What you'll do: Own complex onchain investigations into threat actor infrastructure, scam networks, exploits, and related abuse targeting Coinbase and Base Drive clustering and attribution of illicit actors using blockchain analytics, OSINT, and internal data, then operationalize results into Vertex Synapse and downstream controls Build OSINT and onchain analysis pipelines, queries, and dashboards that automate detections and scale investigative capacity across the team Lead post-incident reviews and root cause analyses to identify gaps and recommend enhancements to controls, detection, and overall security posture Partner with product, engineering, and risk teams to embed threat and abuse mitigation strategies into the product development lifecycle from ideation to launch Lead new investigative techniques, teach them across Security, and brief executives with clear risk, impact, and recommended actions Required Skills and Experience: 5+ years of investigations including 3+ years investigating onchain illicit activity, cryptocurrency abuse, or blockchain intelligence, with a track record of independently leading investigations from collection through stakeholder action Deep knowledge of blockchain ecosystems and protocols, including tracing across chains, bridges, mixers, and laundering patterns Proficient with Python or Go and SQL for data analysis, scripting, or tooling development in support of intelligence workflows and automation Track record of creating investigation methods, dashboards, or pipelines that other investigators adopt Proven ability to translate complex technical analysis into clear, actionable intelligence for both technical and non-technical stakeholders, including executive briefings Skilled in conducting open-source intelligence (OSINT) research across a wide range of topics Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality. items.title: Customer Success Manager, Enterprise Tech
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role Join Anthropic's Customer Success team in a high-visibility & high-impact role driving AI adoption across a small number of enterprise accounts in our Enterprise Tech segment. As our dedicated Customer Success Manager for Enterprise Tech Customers you’ll be their partner and trusted advisor helping them harness the full potential of all our Claude capabilities - API, Claude Code, Cowork, and other surface areas. You'll work with a book of global technology leaders to actively deploy AI and reshape the technology landscape. You’ll be working with key partners who are moving fast and pushing the boundaries of what's possible with LLM technology. Your role will entail developing genuine partnerships with the customer and key stakeholders, gaining a deep understanding of their multi-pronged business objectives, strategic direction, AI vision, and technical needs. You'll draw on both your business acumen and technical expertise to serve as a strategic advisor throughout their journey with us. In partnership with the broader account team, you will help customers identify the right Claude capabilities for their specific business objectives, working closely with them to provide best practices and guidance while supporting them as their usage grows and evolves. Your role focuses on helping customers scale their usage effectively, drive model and use case optimizations, implement change management strategies, and maximize the value of their investment through expanded use cases across their organization. The insights you gather from your customers will directly inform our research priorities, product development, and go-to-market strategies — making you a key voice in shaping how we build and deliver ongoing value as a business. Responsibilities: Build trusting, strategic relationships with key customer decision makers in complex, matrixed organizations; understand their business and objectives and identify opportunities for optimization and expansion Own customer operations across the lifecycle of each account, maintaining a structured operational assessment (customer readiness, operational health, strategic alignment, enablement strategy, adoption intelligence) that grounds comprehensive account and success plans and Executive Business Reviews Become an expert in Anthropic's products across API, Claude Code and Cowork, understanding the technical nuances and best practices for each to guide customers to the right solutions Leverage your deep knowledge of each customer, and the patterns you see across your other Tech accounts, to proactively drive consumption planning and the value story behind it, developing credible ROI hypotheses and quantifying outcomes that build the case for continued and expanded investment. Monitor usage patterns and identify optimization opportunities across Claude surface areas (API, Claude Code, Cowork) to drive full value from contracted commitments Serve as the customer’s thought partner, enhancing their knowledge of Claude products by socializing Anthropic’s product roadmap, driving awareness on new products and engaging Product PMs Develop and execute change management strategies to drive end-user adoption and maximize value within customer organizations, including Train the Trainer programs, Center of Excellence development, and organizational enablement Ruthlessly prioritize across the account's many business units and workstreams, building programmatic, repeatable motions You may be a good fit if you have: 6+ years of experience in Customer Success, Technical Account Management, Solutions Engineering, or Strategy Consulting Experience working with F500 technology companies, SaaS platforms, or digital-first businesses at the exec level—ideally including high-growth and established tech companies. You understand what it means to lead organization-wide change or adoption programs (multiple functions, hundreds of users) for a product that requires C-suite sponsorship Technical fluency with ability to understand and articulate AI/ML concepts, API integrations, and software implementation patterns across a set of diverse stakeholders—from developers and product managers to executives and end users Proven track record managing a portfolio of accounts while maintaining strong relationships and driving measurable outcomes — you can run multiple enterprise motions in parallel without letting any account go quiet. Cross-functional collaborator who represents the customer in a positive, proactive manner, rallying everyone around paths forward that solve customer needs Passion for AI and interest in responsible development of advanced systems. You have built with Claude Code, automating your own workflows with agents, skills, and tooling. A knack for bringing order to chaos and an enthusiastic "roll up your sleeves" mentality The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $151,840 — $200,000 USD Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. items.title: Order to Cash Operations Lead
items.description: About the Team OpenAI Finance ensures the organization is positioned for long-term success as we pursue our mission. The Order to Cash (OTC) team oversees the complete flow of commercial transactions from order intake and provisioning through billing, collections, and cash application — ensuring accuracy, compliance, and operational excellence in support of OpenAI’s mission to ensure artificial general intelligence benefits all of humanity. About the Role We are looking for an experienced OTC lead to help scale OpenAI’s EMEA order management, billing and AR operations, as our commercial business and customer base continue to grow. As a senior individual contributor within the team, you will own the end-to-end order-to-invoice lifecycle for your assigned portfolio. You will assist with improving processes, policies and rigor to ensure our workflows and systems are complete and accurate. This role will have a strong AI, automation, and process-transformation mandate. You will help define how AI and modern tooling can improve order processing, billing, risk identification, customer outreach, reporting, and exception management. You will partner closely with Finance Systems, Product, Engineering, and operational teams to translate these opportunities into scalable workflows that reduce manual effort while maintaining strong judgment, controls, and customer experience. You will also work closely with Billing Operations, Cash Application, Sales, Deal Desk, Customer Success, Legal, Accounting, and other cross-functional partners to resolve complex issues and strengthen the end-to-end order to cash lifecycle. This is an opportunity to help build a more intelligent, automated, and scalable operating model at OpenAI. This role is critical to building the operational backbone for OpenAI’s expansion across the EMEA region. You will combine deep operational judgment with process and control execution, automation, clear communication, and hands-on problem solving to improve billing reliability, partner experience, customer outcomes, and financial integrity at scale. This role is based in our Dublin office. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees. In this role, you will: - Own end-to-end OTC execution across order intake, quote/order validation, provisioning alignment, usage and pricing data readiness, billing execution, invoice review, AR follow-up, cash application dependencies, and customer closeout. - Operate AR collections, credit and cash application workflows across the full customer lifecycle. - Govern offshore BPO execution across OM, Billing, and AR workstreams through daily and weekly queue reviews, prioritization, SOP/training updates, access blockers, quality checks, escalation paths, and SLA follow-through. - Partner cross-functionally with GTM, Deal Desk, Legal, Customer Success, Revenue Accounting, Accounting, Tax, Finance Systems, Product, Engineering, RevOps, and Support to resolve blockers and improve handoffs. - Build and maintain scalable SOPs, playbooks, controls, dashboards, and operating cadences so the function can move from person-dependent execution to repeatable process ownership. - Identify and drive automation and AI-enabled workflow improvements across order validation, invoice accuracy, collections prioritization, dispute routing, reporting, BPO quality, and control evidence. You might thrive in this role if you have: - Strong end to end Order-to-Cash foundation with hands-on experience across order-to-invoice and invoice-to-cash processes. - Ability to operate across Order Management, Billing Operations, AR Collections, credit/customer-risk review, cash application dependencies, reconciliations, and month-end close support. - Experience in complex, high-growth environments with usage-based, subscription, enterprise SaaS, marketplace, partner-channel, or hybrid billing models. - Strong data and systems fluency across CPQ, ERP, billing, payment, and reporting workflows; able to investigate mismatches and identify root causes across systems. - BPO or offshore operating experience, including queue governance, SOP adherence, quality checks, training, escalation management, and performance tracking. - Controls and audit-readiness mindset, including SOX-aware documentation, approval frameworks, evidence retention, reconciliations, and clean handoffs to Accounting/Revenue Accounting. - Strong stakeholder management across GTM, Deal Desk, Customer Success, Legal, Finance, Product, Engineering, and BPO teams. - Comfort with ambiguity, hands-on execution, direct issue ownership, customer-sensitive escalations, and continuous process improvement. - Automation and AI orientation, with curiosity and practical judgment around where tooling can improve prioritization, reporting, controls, outreach, and exception handling. About OpenAI OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. items.title: Sr. Creative Designer (Performance Marketing) - Static & Motion
items.description: BUILDING THE FUTURE OF OPEN FINANCE Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system. Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page https://www.kraken.com/culture to understand what drives us and how we work. THE TEAM Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients. Kraken's Consumer Creative & Design team owns end-to-end creative execution for Kraken Consumer and Krak. Our disciplines cover performance ad creative, static and 3D design, motion design, AI video creative and web design, turning growth strategy into creative that converts across paid, owned and organic surfaces. We work closely with Product Marketing, Performance Marketing, Content & Social, Lifecycle and our regional leads, holding the line on brand and messaging quality on everything that ships. THE OPPORTUNITY As our Senior Performance Creative, you concept, produce and ship paid creative for Kraken Consumer and Krak. Paid static is the center of the role, but we're hiring a hybrid rather than a specialist: this means you also ideate and create performance video and treat gen AI as a core production method rather than a novelty. You take a project from idea to a finished, approved, multi-market asset set, and you bring a real feel for what people stop on, share and screenshot. You report to the Creative Lead, Consumer Creative & Design, who gives you direction, feedback and cover in reviews. This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct reports. Senior here means craft and automation leadership: you set the bar for paid static on the team, work with AI enabled processes, collaborate closely with other Krakenites in and outside the team, and are the person others come to with performance creative questions. - Own paid static for Kraken Consumer across product launches, campaigns, promotions and always-on activity. - Build for channels like Meta, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, Reddit and X. You know what wins where, and you build to each platform's specs and native feel. - Concept and cut performance video so campaigns ship as complete cross-format sets, from 9:16 sound-on to static-adjacent 1:1 and 4:5. - Produce AI-generated and AI-assisted video and imagery, and know when AI is the fastest route to a great ad and when it isn't. - Bring ideas to briefs rather than executing them literally. Pitch culturally timely, internet-native concepts that nobody asked for, and build the winners into creative pillars we can keep using. - Version and localize at scale across markets, languages, formats and regulatory requirements. In a typical month you'll have roughly a dozen workstreams in flight at once, most spanning several formats and several markets. - Build creative that's designed to be tested. Performance Marketing owns test design, cadence and readouts. You own the creative response: reading the results, forming a point of view on why a variant won, and turning that into the next round of hooks, concepts and cuts. - Partner with Product Marketing, compliance and regional teams to get work approved without losing the idea. - Hold a high craft bar on your own work and keep your files clean enough for other people to build on. WHAT YOU’LL BRING - 5+ years in performance creative at a high-volume in-house team or performance agency, ideally in fintech, crypto, gaming or another regulated category. - A portfolio that proves it, submitted with your application. Paid static above all, with the brief or objective alongside the work and the result where you're able to share it. Include two or three full video cuts, at least one AI-generated or AI-assisted piece with a short note on what was tooling and what was you, and one concept you tested where you can talk us through what the data said and what you changed. - Layout, hierarchy, type and composition that hold up at thumbnail size, in feed, and in multiple languages. - Platform-native instincts across Meta, TikTok and YouTube. You can explain why the same idea needs a different build on each one. - Real video skills, from concept to finished, sound-designed cut. - High-level command of gen AI video and image tooling, with shipped work to show for it. - Experience inside a structured creative testing program. You're fluent in the metrics your creative moves (thumb-stop rate, hook rate, CTR, CVR, CPA and ROAS), you can tell a real winner from low performers, and can translate test results into a creative decision. - Fluency in internet and meme culture, with comedic timing and an instinct for what's about to feel dated. - Speed without sloppiness. Comfortable with fast turnarounds, several review rounds and late changes. - Comfort working inside regulatory constraints, with layouts that survive risk warnings and market-specific requirements. - A solid copywriting instinct. Plain language, value first, no hype and no jargon. - Figma and Adobe CC (After Effects, Premiere, Photoshop) as well as strong genAI skills - Curious about investing and crypto at a minimum, and able to make the space legible to others. items.title: Deal Operations, APAC
items.description: OpenAI is seeking a senior individual contributor to support revenue growth across APAC by helping sales teams structure and close commercially sound deals. You will balance speed and responsiveness with pricing discipline, consistent processes, and appropriate financial and commercial controls. In this role, you will be the day-to-day Deal Operations partner for APAC account teams, reviewing pricing, discounts, and commercial terms across new business, renewals, and expansions. You will guide sellers through deal requirements, evaluate non-standard requests, and coordinate the approvals needed to move opportunities through contracting and closure. You will also develop scalable workflows, guidance, and tools that improve deal turnaround times, documentation quality, and consistency across the region. This role partners closely with Sales, Finance, Legal, Pricing, and Revenue Operations, with Product and other teams engaged as needed, to resolve deal issues and support accurate execution from quote through contract and booking. WHAT YOU’LL DO - Serve as the primary Deal Operations contact for APAC account teams, managing deal intake, prioritizing requests, and guiding sellers through pricing, review, and approval processes. - Review quotes and proposed commercial terms, including discounts, payment schedules, contract duration, and customer commitments, for accuracy and alignment with pricing guidelines and commercial policies. - Build financial analyses and deal models to assess revenue, margin, discount impact, and profitability, and explain the tradeoffs of proposed deal structures to decision-makers. - Partner with Sales to structure deals that meet customer needs and OpenAI’s commercial objectives, recommending alternatives when proposed terms fall outside established guidelines. - Coordinate deal reviews and required approvals across Finance, Legal, Pricing, and Revenue Operations. Prepare clear recommendations, document decisions, and escalate exceptions to the appropriate stakeholders. - Identify risks in non-standard terms and work with Legal and Finance to resolve contractual, billing, and revenue recognition considerations before execution. - Maintain complete deal records and approval documentation in CRM, CPQ, and contract management systems, and partner with Revenue Operations to align approved terms, executed agreements, and booking information. - Help develop and maintain deal approval policies, escalation paths, pricing guidance, and standardized templates. Improve workflows to reduce bottlenecks while maintaining appropriate controls. - Equip sellers with practical guidance and training on deal requirements and approval processes. items.description: Join us in building the future of finance. Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading. About the team + role We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world's biggest financial problems. We're looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn't a place for complacency, it's where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We're a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. The Developer Infrastructure org is the engine behind Robinhood's entire engineering organization — a collection of tightly integrated teams whose collective mission is to make every engineer at Robinhood faster, more reliable, and exponentially more productive. The org spans four major teams: DevX (Developer Experience), TestX (Test Infrastructure), Backend Platform, and Mobile Platform. DevX owns Robinhood's monorepo and Bazel-based build infrastructure — the critical layer between a developer writing code and that code being ready to ship — along with the company's full CI/CD pipeline and remote build execution cluster. TestX owns the infrastructure behind Robinhood's entire test experience: the integration test environments, and personal development environments that serve as miniature simulations of the full Robinhood system, giving engineers a safe, isolated space to test their code end-to-end before it ever touches production. Backend Platform and Mobile Platform own the core language runtimes, libraries, IDEs, and developer toolchains across Python, Go, TypeScript, Swift, and Android. Together, these teams share a single north star: leveraging AI and agentic systems to fundamentally transform Robinhood's software development lifecycle — making every engineer dramatically more productive and the entire org a force multiplier for the business. As the Senior Staff Software Developer, Developer Infrastructure , you are the technical driver of this entire org — the Uber Tech Lead unifying DevX, TestX, Backend Platform, and Mobile Platform under one cohesive technical vision. But your influence stretches far wider: you will be a driving force in weaving AI and agentic development deeply into every layer of the software development lifecycle — from intelligent code review and automated build pipelines to agentic coding systems that multiply what each engineer can ship. items.description: BUILDING THE FUTURE OF OPEN FINANCE Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system. Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page https://www.kraken.com/culture to understand what drives us and how we work. THE TEAM Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients. Kraken's Consumer Creative & Design team owns end-to-end creative execution for Kraken Consumer and Krak. Our disciplines cover performance ad creative, static and 3D design, motion design, AI video creative and web design, turning growth strategy into creative that converts across paid, owned and organic surfaces. We work closely with Product Marketing, Performance Marketing, Content & Social, Lifecycle and our regional leads, holding the line on brand and messaging quality on everything that ships. THE OPPORTUNITY As our Senior Performance Creative, you concept, produce and ship paid creative for Kraken Consumer and Krak. Paid static is the center of the role, but we're hiring a hybrid rather than a specialist: this means you also ideate and create performance video and treat gen AI as a core production method rather than a novelty. You take a project from idea to a finished, approved, multi-market asset set, and you bring a real feel for what people stop on, share and screenshot. You report to the Creative Lead, Consumer Creative & Design, who gives you direction, feedback and cover in reviews. This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct reports. Senior here means craft and automation leadership: you set the bar for paid static on the team, work with AI enabled processes, collaborate closely with other Krakenites in and outside the team, and are the person others come to with performance creative questions. - Own paid static for Kraken Consumer across product launches, campaigns, promotions and always-on activity. - Build for channels like Meta, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, Reddit and X. You know what wins where, and you build to each platform's specs and native feel. - Concept and cut performance video so campaigns ship as complete cross-format sets, from 9:16 sound-on to static-adjacent 1:1 and 4:5. - Produce AI-generated and AI-assisted video and imagery, and know when AI is the fastest route to a great ad and when it isn't. - Bring ideas to briefs rather than executing them literally. Pitch culturally timely, internet-native concepts that nobody asked for, and build the winners into creative pillars we can keep using. - Version and localize at scale across markets, languages, formats and regulatory requirements. In a typical month you'll have roughly a dozen workstreams in flight at once, most spanning several formats and several markets. - Build creative that's designed to be tested. Performance Marketing owns test design, cadence and readouts. You own the creative response: reading the results, forming a point of view on why a variant won, and turning that into the next round of hooks, concepts and cuts. - Partner with Product Marketing, compliance and regional teams to get work approved without losing the idea. - Hold a high craft bar on your own work and keep your files clean enough for other people to build on. WHAT YOU’LL BRING - 5+ years in performance creative at a high-volume in-house team or performance agency, ideally in fintech, crypto, gaming or another regulated category. - A portfolio that proves it, submitted with your application. Paid static above all, with the brief or objective alongside the work and the result where you're able to share it. Include two or three full video cuts, at least one AI-generated or AI-assisted piece with a short note on what was tooling and what was you, and one concept you tested where you can talk us through what the data said and what you changed. - Layout, hierarchy, type and composition that hold up at thumbnail size, in feed, and in multiple languages. - Platform-native instincts across Meta, TikTok and YouTube. You can explain why the same idea needs a different build on each one. - Real video skills, from concept to finished, sound-designed cut. - High-level command of gen AI video and image tooling, with shipped work to show for it. - Experience inside a structured creative testing program. You're fluent in the metrics your creative moves (thumb-stop rate, hook rate, CTR, CVR, CPA and ROAS), you can tell a real winner from low performers, and can translate test results into a creative decision. - Fluency in internet and meme culture, with comedic timing and an instinct for what's about to feel dated. - Speed without sloppiness. Comfortable with fast turnarounds, several review rounds and late changes. - Comfort working inside regulatory constraints, with layouts that survive risk warnings and market-specific requirements. - A solid copywriting instinct. Plain language, value first, no hype and no jargon. - Figma and Adobe CC (After Effects, Premiere, Photoshop) as well as strong genAI skills - Curious about investing and crypto at a minimum, and able to make the space legible to others. items.title: GRC & Privacy Lead
items.description: ABOUT POLYMARKET Polymarket is the world's largest prediction market platform. We enable individuals to express views on real-world events by trading on outcomes across politics, economics, sports, culture, and current affairs. Built as a peer-to-peer marketplace with no centralized "house," Polymarket aggregates diverse opinions into transparent, market-based probabilities that reflect collective expectations about the future. We're growing fast — both in terms of volume ($21B traded in 2025) and adoption as an alternative news source. Our ambition is to become a ubiquitous beacon of truth in global media and we need your help adding fuel to the fire. ABOUT THE ROLE Polymarket's IT and Security team is small, senior, and expected to move fast. This role sits at the intersection of third-party risk, audit execution, and privacy operations — and the person in it will own all three. DSARs need to be processed, vendors need risk dispositions before they get access to our systems, and PIAs need to happen before engineering ships, not after. This is a senior IC role. You'll make judgment calls independently, build processes that didn't exist before you arrived, and leave behind documentation the team can actually use. items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role The IT Operations team keeps Anthropic running. We make sure every employee can do their best work without friction. We're hiring an IT Operations Engineer to develop our global asset management and hardware lifecycle program across our offices in San Francisco, New York, Seattle, London, Dublin and Sydney. You will bring program expertise to how we track hardware as inventory through its whole life: procurement and receiving, the inventory of record, assignment, refresh, collection and recovery, e-waste and secure disposal, and reseller relationships, iterating and scaling practices as we mature. The same person runs day-to-day operations for our corporate mobile program in addition to expertise in management of laptop and workstation lifecycle operations. You'll partner with several teams within the IT, Security and business operations organizations: IT Hardware Ops runs procurement, fleet logistics, onboarding and offboarding, the storage room, and physical intake. The Endpoint pod owns MDM, device policy and enrollment. Finance owns the budget and vendor contracts. Hardware requests that come through the IT Support queue land with the IT Support team, and you'll help define how they are handled. Responsibilities Strategy and Tooling Develop the global asset management strategy: the lifecycle model, the data we keep on every device, and how each office executes against it Select, implement and administer the asset management tool, define its data model and integrations, and partner with IT Engineering where the work needs platform-level access Contribute to and develop the processes on-site engineers in each office execute against, including the storage room process Support the evaluation and onboarding of a hardware lifecycle services vendor and, once in place, run the day-to-day relationship Inventory and Assignment Establish the inventory of record across systems and keep it accurate, from receiving through disposal: every device, its state, its location, and who has it Run audits of who-has-what and reconcile physical counts against the system of record Manage demo, loaner, and travel device inventories, ensuring devices are accurately tracked through complex logistical deployments Maintain up-to-date inventory counts and make strategic purchasing decisions in support new hire onboarding and peripherals stock levels Procurement and Refresh Support hardware purchasing through our reseller and vendor relationships, working from the refresh calendar Build out the refresh calendar and advance it across offices Reconcile purchase orders, deliveries and invoices with Accounting and vendors so that what was ordered, received, and billed line up Collection, E-waste and Disposal Develop device collection and recovery workflows: offboarding returns, refresh swaps, remote-employee returns and the BPO fleet, including the shipping and tracking that goes with them Build the e-waste program: certified recycling and secure disposal partners in each region, data destruction records, and the chain of custody from collection to certificate Handle equipment under legal hold or other chain-of-custody requirements BPO and Contingent Fleet Provision, track and recover the device fleet for our BPO partners, and be the day-to-day hardware contact for those vendors Corporate Mobile Run day-to-day operations for the corporate mobile program and write its runbook Manage deployment, break-fix, and carrier relationships associated with a mobile device fleet Automation Identify repetitive work throughout the operation and automate it with the tools at hand (scripts, systems integrations / connectors, AI tools) You may be a good fit if you Have implemented an asset management and lifecycle program for a multi-office fleet, not only run one: taken it from spreadsheets or nothing to a system of record and defined the processes around it (procurement, inventory, assignment, refresh, collection and disposal), ideally in a fast-paced or high-growth environment Have selected or implemented an asset management platform such as Jira Assets, Snipe-IT or similar, and developed the data model Have run an e-waste or secure disposal program with certified partners and chain-of-custody records Have managed reseller or vendor relationships for hardware purchasing and asset disposal Write things down: runbooks, how-to guides and knowledge base articles Recognize when a request reaches past this role and route platform work to IT Engineering, policy to the Endpoint pod, and budget to Finance Strong candidates may also Have supported a corporate mobile program or carrier account Have basic scripting experience (Bash or Python) for inventory or reporting automation Have experience using AI tools to improve personal or team productivity Have been the hands-on asset contact for an ISO 27001 or SOC 2 audit: pulled extracts from the register, produced disposal certificates and evidence of returned assets Deadline to apply: None. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.
